newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS cuts forecast for Ares-Serono.
newsitem.headline: UBS cuts forecast for Ares-Serono.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland said it cut its earning forecast for Swiss health and personal care group Ares-Serono but maintained its "hold" recommendation.

"Given the sinking sales and profit dynamics, we are reducing our profit estimate for the current year from $44.4 million to $43.0 million," it said in a research note. It cut its 1996 EPS outlook to 13.8 Swiss francs from 14.2.

Ares-Serono, which posted a 1995 net profit of $29.4 million, reported profit growth slowed to six percent in the third quarter from 15 percent in the first half. Sales growth slowed to 33 percent from 70 percent. -- Zurich +41 1 631 7340
